title: Add Two Numbers
description:
Add two numbers represented as linked lists in reverse order.

Input Format:
First line: n m
Second line: l1 digits
Third line: l2 digits

Output Format:
Space-separated sum digits

python.footer:
def main():
    raw = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    if not raw:
        return
    lines = [l.strip() for l in raw.split('\n') if l.strip()]
    if len(lines) < 3:
        return
    parts1 = lines[0].split()
    n = int(parts1[0])
    m = int(parts1[1])
    vals1 = [int(x) for x in lines[1].split()]
    vals2 = [int(x) for x in lines[2].split()]
    d1 = ListNode(0)
    c1 = d1
    for v in vals1:
        c1.next = ListNode(v)
        c1 = c1.next
    d2 = ListNode(0)
    c2 = d2
    for v in vals2:
        c2.next = ListNode(v)
        c2 = c2.next
    res = addTwoNumbers(d1.next, d2.next)
    out = []
    while res:
        out.append(str(res.val))
        res = res.next
    print(' '.join(out))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
